items.text: Put your photo ID somewhere you cannot leave without it. The La Cañada gate will ask for it tomorrow evening.
EL NIÑO: two gaps are yours. The xlsx column headings (a photo of the header row does it), and whether to name Canadian projects by number.
Write to Olivier: you will miss the 14 Sept bilat. Your own ask.
09:30 Moving quotes, Intermud + Cropa, Casa Cañada. Oscar Chavac / Scarlet Veliz.
17:30 British Residence, 11 Av 21-34 Zona 14 La Cañada. Drinks 17:30, dialogue 18:00. You go in Olivier's place.
Fix the OPS before Olivier sees it: 'fertiliser up 15%' is WFP's model assumption, not observed. Use gasoline, up 40%+.
EL NIÑO TABLE due OOB Mon 14 — which is your packing day. Real deadline FRIDAY 11. Wed is Escobal from 05:00, Fri is Cervecería from 11:00.
Submit the October leave form. Olivier already approved it. Three minutes.
Buy Claro for the new SQ. The INSTALL APPOINTMENT is the part with a lead time.
Tigo 17082124 is the OLD flat's internet. Move it or close it, separately.
FSD dental claim. Form M445D, plan 72114, cert ECF0152001.
Tigo bill due the 10th.
Report the outage pattern: 2 Sept 09:58, 3 Sept 05:42, 4 Sept 16:22.
House app: brief is with Astra. Import the existing Issue Register and Prioritized Maintenance Plan rather than retyping them.
Time Machine to an external drive. The closet Mac still has no backup.
